name: COLD GAS
tagline: Ten thrusters. One roll. Stick the landing.
paused: No truthful captures yet: the native build is the phase-0 spike (a car on a turntable with a debug readout; no course, HUD, jets or judges). Web captures would show features the app doesn't have. Unpause when docs/NATIVE.md phases 3-4 are in the build and the -demo/-course/-autopilot/-results launch flags exist; the shots below name what to capture.

capture.notes: ios/scripts/shots.sh shoots the spike today. For store art, extend it once these exist (docs/NATIVE.md §8): -demo -course show|wall -tier assist|advanced -play -autopilot -results, -pose/-window for the Duo. Hide the debug readout. 1-flight: the car inverted over the row, jets on. 2-roll: the one-thumb pad mid-roll. 3-panel: the results sheet with the panel's words. 4-touchdown: the wheels meeting the pad with the landing HUD. 5-wall: the climb to the ledge. 6-valves: Advanced's ten valves. 7-book: book pose, Duo only.

shots.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
shots.sub: Ten cold-gas thrusters. One roll. One mark to land on.

shots.title: Hold to fly. *Roll it over.*
shots.sub: Assist flies the valves. You choose when to go.

shots.title: Three judges. *No excuses.*
shots.sub: A deterministic scorer decides the numbers. The judges only supply the words.

shots.title: Feel *every wheel* land.
shots.sub: A synced landing is one clean thump. A sloppy one is four.

shots.title: Climb it. *Hang there.*
shots.sub: Up the curl and under the ledge, then let go.

shots.title: Fly *ten valves* by hand.
shots.sub: Assist, Pro, Advanced: take away the computer one tier at a time.

shots.title: Open it. *Fly it.*
shots.sub: The scene on one side, the instruments on the other. Nothing crosses the fold.

feature.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
